def factor_drawdown_depth_atr_adaptive(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    peak = df_copy["close"].rolling(63, min_periods=63).max()
    dd = (df_copy["close"] - peak) / peak
    depth = (-dd)
    high_low = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    high_close = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs()
    low_close = (df_copy["low"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs()
    tr = pd.concat([high_low, high_close, low_close], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    atr_63 = tr.rolling(63, min_periods=63).mean()
    atr_20 = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    atr_120 = tr.rolling(120, min_periods=120).mean()
    exp_ratio = atr_20 / atr_120.replace(0, np.nan)
    exp_ratio_clipped = np.clip(exp_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)
    normalized_depth = depth / atr_63.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = normalized_depth * exp_ratio_clipped
    factor = factor.fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr_adaptive"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr_adaptive"]
